articles.title: DigitalOcean’s Inference Cloud Platform, Powered by AMD Instinct GPUs, Delivers 2X Production Inference Performance for Character.ai
articles.mainIdea: DigitalOcean’s Inference Cloud Platform, Powered by AMD Instinct GPUs, Delivers 2X Production Inference Performance for Character.ai
articles.summary: Business Wire: DigitalOcean’s Inference Cloud Platform, Powered by AMD Instinct GPUs, Delivers 2X Production Inference Performance for Character.ai. BROOMFIELD, Colo., January 13, 2026--DigitalOcean (NYSE: DOCN) today announced that its Inference Cloud Platform is delivering 2X production inference throughput for Character.ai, a leading AI entertainment platform operating one of the most demanding production inference workloads in the market handling over a billion queries per day, through a tightly integrated software and hardware collaboration with AMD. Related tickers mentioned: DOCN.

articles.title: Le Pen appeal trial opens with French presidential bid at stake
articles.mainIdea: Le Pen appeal trial opens with French presidential bid at stake
articles.summary: AFP: Le Pen appeal trial opens with French presidential bid at stake. The appeal trial of Marine Le Pen opened Tuesday, with the French far-right leader hoping to overthrow a graft conviction and save her 2027 run for president.If she cannot be a candidate, Le Pen has said her top lieutenant Jordan Bardella -- the RN party's president who is not a defendant in the trial -- can run in her place.

articles.summary: Barrons.com: These Stocks Are Today’s Movers: JPMorgan, Delta, L3Harris, Intel, AMD, BNY Mellon, and More. Stock futures were falling Tuesday as investors digested quarterly results from JPMorgan Chase and Delta Air Lines both of which kicked off the earnings season. JPMorgan Chase rose 0.4%. Although the bank’s profit declined 7% in the fourth quarter, revenue rose on the back of higher fees and interest income. Related tickers mentioned: BK, DAL, GOOG, INTC, JPM.
